about.headline: Central Columbus calm.
about.body: Happy Feet Relaxing opened in 2019 to give Columbus a non-medical, drug-free way to reset — increase blood flow, ease stress, and leave lighter than you arrived. You'll find us on the north side of Bethel near Sawmill, between the Crepe Shop and Avis, walking distance to Walmart. Reasonable prices and monthly specials.
